glossary.Delivery Retry:
The explicit act that returns one parked Delivery Queue item to the stage supported by its recorded evidence and hands it to a live or newly started queue owner. It may perform Task Carry-Forward from every Run of the item's Spec, newest first, and is never automatic.
_Avoid_: Resume Command, automatic retry, replay
glossary.Delivery Queue:
The durable, ordered set of Specs that Roundfix advances from an Implement Run through merge with a fixed optional deadline and per-item retry limit. A blocker parks only its item while later items can continue.
_Avoid_: Release queue, Batch, Run list
glossary.QA Archive Override:
An explicit user request or applicable prior authorization to archive a covered
Spec despite its QA prerequisite being unmet. The recorded exception preserves
actual QA and Task evidence while retaining non-QA completion, source integrity
and separate delivery gates.
_Avoid_: QA pass, QA bypass, Implement Clean
glossary.Delivery Convention:
A commit shape the delivery itself produces — the QA Report commit, the Daemon's status writes, the archive commit, an all-pending planning candidate — that the pre-PR reviewer is told about and never raises as a defect (ADR-0196).
_Avoid_: Review exemption, ignore list

assessment.Delivery Retry: Descendant retry returns to reviewing, an evidence-supported stage; definition remains accurate.
assessment.Delivery Queue: Continued branch changes provisioning, not durable order or item parking; accurate.
assessment.QA Archive Override: C5 recognizes recorded user authority without changing failed QA or separate gates; accurate.
assessment.Delivery Convention: Authorized archive is another designed commit shape, within existing definition; accurate.
assessment.active_directory_pin: Concrete path hazard, documented in spec/archive guides; no new domain entity.
assessment.malformed: Verification classification, documented in spec guide; no new glossary term.

spec_promise_rule: Strict own-Spec check passed, coverage maps all Goals/stories/features/metrics, numbered transcripts name inputs and exit codes and map to implementation Tasks and terminal QA. No tests/build read this active Spec as a runtime dependency. Observed output-contract mismatches are separately failed in R2/R3/R5.
intentional_breaks: Existing authoring classifications add malformed; API output terms have documentation assertions.
